in_sanskrit.name: आनन्द
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अनन्त: अन्त: Endless + द: Giver. Ananda means the infinite giver of happiness and bliss.

in_hindi.name: आनन्द
in_hindi.meaning: आनन्द: आ: Towards + न्न्: Nna + द: Giver. Ananda means moving towards the giver of happiness and bliss.

in_tamil.name: ஆனந்த
in_tamil.meaning: ஆன்: Towards + ந்: N + த: Born. Ananda means born towards happiness and bliss.

in_telugu.name: ఆనంద
in_telugu.meaning: ఆన్: Towards + న్: N + ద: Giver. Ananda means moving towards the giver of happiness and bliss.

in_marathi.name: Ananda
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ananda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ananda is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'ananda', which means 'bliss' or 'happiness'.
